c: Feed 100 g ripe starter with 200 g flour (80/20 bread/rye) and 100 g water at 26 °C; knead to a firm ball.
Ripe in 8–10 h at 24 °C (domed, cracked top, mild acidity); refrigerate at 4 °C for overnight holds max 16 h.
Convert stiff → liquid: feed 1 : 4 : 4 twice at 26 °C. Liquid levain = milder lactic flavour, faster; stiff = more acetic, stronger structure.
Weekly: dry 20 g ripe starter spread thin on baking paper 48 h; store flakes airtight (revive with flour + water 2 feeds).
Label the master jar with feeding times; clean jar every 3 days; discard any pink/orange growth.
Production rule: levain at 20% of total flour for overnight cold retard; 10% for 18 h ambient doughs.
d266fde1.st: Ripe levain 0–4 °C max 16 h; dried back-up 6 months.
d266fde1.al: 1 Gluten (sourdough starter, strong bread flour, rye flour). Method card.

c: Baker's %: flour = 100%; every ingredient as % of total flour. Hydration includes water in the levain.
DDT 24–26 °C: water temp = (DDT × 4) − (flour + room + levain + friction 10–12 °C spiral).
Salt 2.0–2.2% of flour; levain 10–25%; autolyse 30–60 min (flour + 90% water only).
08:00 feed levain · 16:00 autolyse · 17:00 mix (levain, salt, bassinage) · 17:15–20:00 bulk with 4 sets of folds at 30 min.
20:00 divide, pre-shape, bench rest 20 min, final shape into bannetons · 20:30 retard 4 °C, 12–14 h.
07:00 bake from cold: 250 °C deck with steam 20 min, vent, 230 °C 20–25 min; core 96–98 °C; cool on racks.
66408f78.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Reference card.

c: Build at 24–26 °C until doubled, domed and just past peak sourness (pH ≈ 4.2); use at peak.
Autolyse flour with 580 g water 1 h at 26 °C; add levain; pinch in; rest 20 min; add salt with 40 g water (bassinage).
Bulk 4 h at 26 °C with coil folds every 30 min (first 2 h) until +50% volume, jiggly, bubbly edges.
Divide 2 × 900 g; pre-shape; rest 20 min; tight bâtard; rice-floured banneton; retard 14 h at 4 °C.
Score at 30° (ear); bake 250 °C in Dutch oven/steam 20 min, uncovered 230 °C 22 min; core 97 °C.
c64fd656.st: Cool on racks ≥ 2 h before slicing. Ambient in paper/linen 2 days; freeze whole loaves −18 °C 1 month, refresh 180 °C 8 min.
c64fd656.al: 1 Gluten (sourdough starter, strong bread flour, wholemeal wheat flour).

c: Build at 24–26 °C until doubled, domed and just past peak sourness (pH ≈ 4.2); use at peak.
Hot-soak the wheat germ in 60 g of the water; autolyse flours with 540 g water 45 min.
Add levain, honey, salt and germ; slap-and-fold 5 min to medium gluten.
Bulk 4.5 h at 25 °C with 3 sets of folds; shape 2 boules; retard 12 h.
Bake 245 °C with steam 20 min, then 225 °C 25 min (wholegrain browns faster: tent if needed).
b039edde.st: Cool on racks ≥ 2 h before slicing. Ambient in paper/linen 2 days; freeze whole loaves −18 °C 1 month, refresh 180 °C 8 min.
b039edde.al: 1 Gluten (sourdough starter, wholemeal wheat flour, strong bread flour, wheat germ).

c: Build at 24–26 °C until doubled, domed and just past peak sourness (pH ≈ 4.2); use at peak.
Spelt gluten is fragile: mix gently 4 min slow, 1 min fast; no long autolyse (20 min max).
Bulk 3 h at 25 °C, 2 gentle folds; shape into oiled 1 kg tins.
Proof 2–3 h until 1 cm above the rim (or retard 10 h).
Bake 230 °C with steam 15 min, 210 °C 25 min; unmould at once.
06f0573d.st: Cool on racks ≥ 2 h before slicing. Ambient in paper/linen 2 days; freeze whole loaves −18 °C 1 month, refresh 180 °C 8 min.
06f0573d.al: 1 Gluten (sourdough starter, spelt flour, strong bread flour).

c: Build at 24–26 °C until doubled, domed and just past peak sourness (pH ≈ 4.2); use at peak.
Autolyse 1 h; add levain, salt and the tiny yeast (security); mix to medium development; DDT 23 °C.
Bulk 1 h ambient with 2 folds, then 18 h at 4 °C.
Divide 8 × 270 g cold; pre-shape cylinders; rest 30 min; shape 55 cm baguettes; couche; proof 45 min.
Score 5 overlapping cuts; bake 250 °C heavy steam 22–24 min.
794ec2d4.st: Same day only; freeze par-baked 1 month.

c: Build at 24–26 °C until doubled, domed and just past peak sourness (pH ≈ 4.2); use at peak.
Mix to medium development (stiff levain cut into pieces); DDT 25 °C.
Bulk 3 h with 2 folds; shape one 2 kg miche; floured linen banneton; retard 12 h.
Score a large cross or 'polka'; bake 240 °C steam 20 min, 210 °C 45–50 min (deep bake, core 98 °C).
Rest 12 h before slicing (rye crumb sets).
80bf1db3.st: Keeps 4–5 days in linen; flavour peaks day 2.
80bf1db3.al: 1 Gluten (sourdough starter, strong bread flour, wheat flour, rye flour, wholemeal wheat flour).

c: Build at 24–26 °C until doubled, domed and just past peak sourness (pH ≈ 4.2); use at peak.
Soaker: toast seeds (except linseed) 160 °C 8 min; soak all with 150 g of the water 4 h.
Mix dough with the rest of the water; add soaker after gluten development.
Bulk 4 h, 3 folds; shape; roll the top in wet towel then extra sesame/sunflower; retard 12 h.
103799c9.st: Cool on racks ≥ 2 h before slicing. Ambient in paper/linen 2 days; freeze whole loaves −18 °C 1 month, refresh 180 °C 8 min.
103799c9.al: 1 Gluten (sourdough starter, strong bread flour, wholemeal wheat flour) · 11 Sesame (sesame seeds).

c: Build at 24–26 °C until doubled, domed and just past peak sourness (pH ≈ 4.2); use at peak.
Drain and pat dry olives; halve. Salt reduced to 1.8% (olives are salty).
Fold olives, rosemary, zest and oil in at the first fold (lamination on the bench keeps them whole).
Bulk 4 h; shape 2 bâtards; retard 12 h; score one long slash.
b4b3e9d1.st: Cool on racks ≥ 2 h before slicing. Ambient in paper/linen 2 days; freeze whole loaves −18 °C 1 month, refresh 180 °C 8 min.

c: Build at 24–26 °C until doubled, domed and just past peak sourness (pH ≈ 4.2); use at peak.
Soak diced figs in warm water 20 min; drain. Toast and crush fennel seed.
Laminate figs, hazelnuts and fennel in at the first fold.
Bulk 4 h; shape 4 small bâtards (for the cheese trolley); retard 12 h.
Bake 240 °C steam 15 min, 220 °C 15–18 min (fruit burns: lower top heat).
d4d8bfc1.st: Cool on racks ≥ 2 h before slicing. Ambient in paper/linen 2 days; freeze whole loaves −18 °C 1 month, refresh 180 °C 8 min.
d4d8bfc1.al: 1 Gluten (sourdough starter, strong bread flour, wholemeal wheat flour) · 8 Nuts (hazelnuts).

c: Build at 24–26 °C until doubled, domed and just past peak sourness (pH ≈ 4.2); use at peak.
Use a sweet stiff levain (fed with sugar, 3 feeds) to tame acidity.
Mix flour, eggs, milk, sugar, salt and levain to full development (8 min); add cold butter in 4 stages; dough 24 °C max.
Bulk 3 h at 26 °C, then 12 h at 4 °C; divide 6 × 150 g; ball; place 3 per tin.
Proof 4–6 h at 28 °C (slow); egg-wash twice; bake 170 °C 35 min.
3aa73768.st: Airtight 3 days; slice for French toast day 3.
3aa73768.al: 1 Gluten (sourdough starter, strong bread flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (milk 3%, butter 82%).

c: Rye sour: rye flour + water + starter, 16 h at 24 °C (ripe, pleasantly sour).
Soaker: cracked rye/wheat grains and sunflower seeds in hot water 16 h, covered.
Mix all with sour and soaker 10 min slow (paste, no gluten); rest 30 min.
Fill 2 greased Pullman tins with wet hands; smooth; proof 1.5–2 h until cracks appear.
Wrap in linen; rest 24 h before slicing thin (8 mm).
8d2aa5b9.st: Wrapped 1 week ambient; slices freeze well.
8d2aa5b9.al: 1 Gluten (rye flour, sourdough starter, wheat grains).

c: Mix to a batter; ferment 12–16 h at 18 °C until bubbly and just collapsing.
Mix flour, poolish and 70% of the water to strong gluten in the spiral; add the rest of the water slowly (bassinage) and salt; oil last.
Bulk 3 h in an oiled tub, 4 coil folds; very gently tip onto a heavily floured bench.
Cut 6 rectangles without degassing; stretch onto peels; rest 20 min.
Bake 260 °C deck with steam 18–20 min until thin-crusted and glassy; cool; split horizontally.
ea160b7a.st: Same day; split, toast and rub with tomato to order.

c: Mix to strong gluten with 700 g water; bassinage rest; add salt and 20 g oil.
Coil fold 4 times in 2 h; oil the tub; retard 72 h at 3 °C (deep flavour, big blisters).
Tip into a well-oiled tray; rest 2 h at 26 °C; stretch to corners; proof 2 h until jiggly.
Dimple to the base with oily fingers; pour emulsified oil-water brine; salt and rosemary.
Bake 240 °C bottom heat 22–25 min; brush with oil out of the oven.
70fb557f.st: Same day; reheat 200 °C 4 min. Freeze 1 month.
70fb557f.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour 00, strong bread flour, sourdough starter).

c: Soak raisins in warm water 20 min; drain well.
Mix flour, starter, milk, sugar and salt to medium development; add soft butter; then raisins on slow.
Bulk 4 h at 26 °C with 2 folds; retard 10 h at 4 °C.
Divide in 2; roll 25 × 35 cm; egg-wash lightly (glue, avoids gaps); sprinkle cinnamon sugar; roll tight; place seam down in tins.
Proof 3–4 h at 27 °C to 1 cm above the rim; egg-wash; bake 190 °C 40 min (core 94 °C); unmould at once.
9d82e9c7.st: Airtight 3 days; slice and toast; freeze 1 month.
9d82e9c7.al: 1 Gluten (strong bread flour, wholemeal wheat flour, sourdough starter) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (milk 3%, butter 82%).

c: Mix flour, starter, milk, butter and honey; knead 6 min; retard 12 h at 4 °C.
Add salt and baking soda; knead 2 min; roll 2 cm; cut 9 cm rounds; semolina both sides; proof 1 h.
Cook on a 160 °C griddle 7 min each side; finish 5 min at 180 °C oven (core 95 °C); split with a fork.
72c8d8e7.st: Airtight 2 days; freeze 1 month; toast to order.
72c8d8e7.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour, sourdough starter, semolina) · 7 Milk (milk 3%, butter 82%).
